study_identification_part.si_4_title: Charting brain growth and aging at high spatial precision

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: Public datasets listed in Materials and methods (ABCD, ABIDE, ADHD200, CAMCAN, CMI-HBN, HCP-Aging, HCP-Development, HCP-Early Psychosis, HCP-Young Adult, IXI, NKI-RS, Oasis, OpenNeuro, PNC, UKBiobank) plus additional single-site studies (UMich, UC Davis, Oslo, KCL, Amsterdam UMC); mapped to the closest Minor Category labels. OpenNeuro transfer set and other site-specific studies are captured under MULTI-SITE (N>=2).
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: "Data from 82 sites were combined to create the initial full sample... Many sites were pulled from publicly available data sets including ABCD, ABIDE, ADHD200, CAMCAN, CMI-HBN, HCP-Aging, HCP-Development, HCP-Early Psychosis, HCP-Young Adult, IXI, NKI-RS, Oasis, OpenNeuro, PNC, SRPBS, and UKBiobank... Other included data come from studies conducted at the University of Michigan... University of California Davis... University of Oslo... King's College London... and Amsterdam University Medical Center."

answer.ABIDE: normative training/testing controls; clinical validation (patient test)

answer.ADHD-200: normative training/testing controls; clinical validation (patient test)

answer.HCP-EP: normative training/testing controls; clinical validation (patient test)

answer.TOP: normative training/testing controls; clinical validation (patient test)

answer.MULTI-SITE (N>=2): additional single-site studies for training/testing and clinical validation; OpenNeuro.org used as a transfer dataset

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: Full sample split into train/test for the reference cohort; a transfer set from OpenNeuro.org (six sites) used for generalizability; clinical validation sample drawn from specific datasets/sites (ABIDE, ADHD200, CNP/SRPBS sites, HCP-EP, KCL, UMich cohorts, TOP).
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: "Equal sized training and testing data sets (split half) were created..."; "To show generalizability of the models to new data not included in training, we leveraged data from OpenNeuro.org... to create a transfer data set (six sites, N=546, Supplementary file 3)."; "The clinical validation sample consisted of a subset of the full data set... Studies (sites) contributing clinical data included: Autism Brain Imaging Database Exchange (ABIDE...); ADHD200...; CNP, SRPBS...; Human Connectome Project Early Psychosis...; KCL...; University of Michigan...; and TOP (University of Oslo)."

model-1.model-name: reference cohort structural MRI (cortical thickness and subcortical volume)
